claims.text: The funding opportunity is for research to understand barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
The research should focus on inter-generational changes, continuities, and challenges in racially diverse UK.
The funding is for research on racial diversity within the UK.
Grants from £15,000 to £500,000 are available.
There is one deadline a year for this fund, in the Autumn.
The next deadline is 5 October 2026.
The priority theme for 2026 applications is Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK.
The research should contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and/or practice on tackling racial inequalities, discrimination and disadvantage.
The research should map pathways towards a UK that is comfortable with and reaping the benefits of its growing racial diversity.
The funding is related to the Commonwealth and the future of UK society as shaped by its colonial past.
The funding is interested in the migration of people from former British colonies to the UK and its impact on racial diversity, discrimination, and inequality.
The funding takes a broad view of racial diversity, including White populations.
Applicants from diverse backgrounds are encouraged, particularly from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities.
Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
Potential applicants can discuss research ideas with the fund, including at early stages.
Contact RDUK@nuffieldfoundation.org to discuss research ideas.

claims.text: Applicants must be employed by, or have a formal affiliation with, a UK-based organisation.
The UK-based organisation can be a university, research organisation, or voluntary sector body.
The employment or formal affiliation must last for at least the duration of the project.
Unaffiliated individuals are excluded.
Projects led by schools or FE colleges are excluded.
Undergraduates or master's students are excluded.
PhD-fee projects are excluded.
Establishment of academic posts is excluded.
Non-UK-led organisations are excluded, except in exceptional circumstances for overseas hosts.
Proposals must show relevance.
Proposals must show impact.
Proposals must show a clear conceptual framework.
Proposals must show rigour.
Proposals must show appropriate experience.
Proposals must show value for money.
Proposals must address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's priority questions.
Proposals from individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
